reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. We went through many concepts, building up to what makes up modern cryptography. Homework was the most fun, proving important theorems. Exams weren't difficult with recall a proof in homework, in fact the lowest scoring was the True/False section. There's lots of extra credit to make up any mistakes though difficult.

Lectures are pretty boring and hard to learn from. Tests are hard, but all of it comes from notes and hw. I would recommend finding a tutor or something if you take him. Good thing was he offered extra credit on most homeworks and test corrections for 50% of your lost points back.

His 470 class was pretty difficult. He makes sure you understand the concept and ask challenging questions during the exams. What is extremely nice is he follows the book, so you do not have to go to class. Reading the book is a MUST. The exam averages were pretty low. He curved them, but still hard. He is extremely smart and understands the mat.

reviews.comment: I think Professor Yoo was an ok pick for 251. His quizzes are pretty difficult in my opinion, and sometimes he wasn't really clear when explaining topics. He does provide practice exams (which are extremely useful) but you do need to dig through his Canvas page to find them (they are usually on other profs' websites).
